idea-plugin.name: Bootstrap Toolkit
idea-plugin.description:
Bootstrap 5.3 live templates that work in HTML, React (JSX/TSX) and Vue templates. Type an abbreviation such as bs5-card and press Tab.

Features

  • One template, every dialect: in JSX/TSX you get className, htmlFor, self-closed tags, style={{...}} and numeric props like tabIndex={-1}. Every JSX template is type-checked with TypeScript and the React types.
  • Ready-to-use page: bs5-starter creates a full HTML page with Bootstrap 5.3.8 CSS and JS and Bootstrap Icons from the jsDelivr CDN, with integrity hashes.
  • Pick instead of type: colors, variants, placements and icons are offered as a completion list.
  • Real photos: cards and carousels use picsum.photos images instead of script-dependent placeholders.
  • Only Bootstrap 5.3 markup, taken from the official documentation. No Bootstrap 4 classes.

Templates

  • Page: bs5-starter (HTML files)
  • Layout: bs5-container, bs5-grid, bs5-col, bs5-row-cols, bs5-stack
  • Navigation: bs5-navbar, bs5-footer, bs5-offcanvas, bs5-tabs, bs5-breadcrumb, bs5-pagination, bs5-dropdown, bs5-scrollspy
  • Content: bs5-card, bs5-card-header, bs5-card-link, bs5-carousel, bs5-accordion, bs5-collapse, bs5-table, bs5-list-group, bs5-img, bs5-figure, bs5-ratio, bs5-display, bs5-blockquote, bs5-icon-link
  • Buttons and feedback: bs5-btn, bs5-btn-group, bs5-close, bs5-alert, bs5-badge, bs5-modal, bs5-toast, bs5-spinner, bs5-progress, bs5-placeholder, bs5-popover, bs5-tooltip
  • Forms: bs5-form, bs5-form-grid, bs5-validation, bs5-input-group, bs5-floating, bs5-select, bs5-check, bs5-radio, bs5-switch, bs5-range
  • Icons: bs5-icon (Bootstrap Icons)

Usage

Type the abbreviation and press Tab; press Tab again to move between the editable fields. Ctrl+J / ⌘J lists all templates. Customize them under Settings | Editor | Live Templates | Bootstrap Toolkit.

Privacy

The plugin collects no data and makes no network requests. The inserted markup links to jsDelivr and picsum.photos, which your browser loads when you open the page.

Unofficial plugin, not affiliated with or endorsed by the Bootstrap team. Bootstrap and Bootstrap Icons are by the Bootstrap Authors (MIT); template markup is adapted from the Bootstrap documentation (CC BY 3.0). Source code: github.com/jamesmosq/bootstrap-toolkit.
